stadiumQuiz.q1title: What is the largest football stadium in the world?
stadiumQuiz.q1hint: This refers to a football stadium, not the largest venue for all sports.
stadiumQuiz.q1fact: Rungrado 1st of May Stadium in Pyongyang is considered the largest football stadium. Recent seat estimates are around 114,000; the older official figure of 150,000 is disputed.
stadiumQuiz.q2title: Which stadium is larger – Azadi (Iran) or Rome's Olympic Stadium (Italy)?
stadiumQuiz.q2hint: Compare the seating capacities of the two arenas.
stadiumQuiz.q2fact: According to the AFC, Azadi Stadium has a capacity of 78,116. Rome's Stadio Olimpico holds about 69,689.
stadiumQuiz.q3title: Which of these three stadiums has the most seats?
stadiumQuiz.q3hint: Three famous football venues in Europe and South America.
stadiumQuiz.q3fact: Wembley holds around 90,000 spectators, Signal Iduna Park around 81,000 and Maracanã around 79,000.
stadiumQuiz.q4title: Which stadium hosted the 2022 World Cup final?
stadiumQuiz.q4hint: Argentina and France played a legendary final.
stadiumQuiz.q4fact: On December 18, 2022, Argentina defeated France on penalties at Lusail Stadium in Qatar.
stadiumQuiz.q5title: Which stadium hosted the 2010 World Cup final?
stadiumQuiz.q5hint: Spain won their first World Cup title there against the Netherlands.
stadiumQuiz.q5fact: The 2010 World Cup final took place at Soccer City (now usually called FNB Stadium) in Johannesburg. Spain won 1–0 after extra time.
